All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AIManager
Manages communication with the AI assistant by sending user prompts and task information to the OpenAI API.
ChatPanel
Provides the interface that lets users to communicate with Effica AI.
Controller
Central controller for the Effica application Is the bridge between user interface, networking layer, timer system, calendar, & AI assistant
ControllerTest
Test for the controller class.
DataStorage
Task information is saved to files & loaded from files, allowing users to preserve tasks between sessions.
EfficaUI
main user interface for the effica application Is a hub for task management, Pomodoro timer, AI assistant, & calendar views within a tab based interface Acts as the main front end connecting the features
LoginFrame
Login window for the Effica application Frame allows users to enter username & password If sucessful, main Effica UI is launched, otherwise error msg displayed
LoginUI
Login interface for the Effica application Allows users to log in or to create a new account (register) On a successful login, the main application UI launches
Main
This class launches the program by initialzing the Login UI.
NetworkClient
Handles all communication between the client application and the backend TaskServer Sends HTTP requests for user authentication & task management Converts server responses into Task objects Bridge between UI and remote server
PriorityCalculator
 
SortMode
Defines the available task sorting & comparing methods used by task manager & task comparator
Task
A task is created, storing information on its name, due date, estimated time completion, associated class grade, completion status, priority, & task ID
TaskComparator
Generates comparators used to sort tasks based on different priority & scheduling strategies.
TaskEditorDialog
Provides a dialog window for creating & editing tasks.
TaskManager
Manages a collection of tasks and provides methods for adding, removing, sorting, editing, & retrieving tasks
TaskServer
HTTP server that takes care of user authentication & task management requests for the application.
Timer
Represents a productivity timer that alternates between work sessions & break sessions.
User
Represents a user of the task management system Each user has a username and password
WeeklyCalendar
Provides calendar based task orgnization and retrieval Takes information stored in the task manager Tasks can be viewed by date, week, or overdue status
